review.notes: Full re-review after 549 changed lines. All ten previous findings repaired (R01-R07 verified by computation: folded Ford region and multiplicity w_K/2, superpair form operator reproducing the 4.4 recurrence, A_pr modulo annihilator, MaassForms 2.1(v) Mellin transform, degree-zero cusp homology spectral separation q-1 > 2 sqrt q for q >= 7, ClassicalArithmeticCompletion 7.0 and ImaginaryQuadraticClassNumber H1.4/H3.1/H3.6 contracts resolved on main). Seeded sample of 15 targets checked against cremona1984, sengun2014, vogtmann1985, bcgnt2025, langlands1980, casselman1973, newtonthorne2015, dlmf-bessel and cremonawhitley1994 at their locators; Swan, Bianchi, Harder, Weil, Bygott, Lingham and the LMFDB knowls not readable. Adversarial table: 45 target rows plus 5 Lean-definition rows with computed values (point counts of 11a1 and 20a1, Ford-floor face lists for d=19,43,67,163 by direct maximisation, Mellin constants, Atkin-Lehner signs). All supplier citations resolved on main or at open heads; depcheck 204 roadmaps, 1615 edges, 0 problems; MaassForms (same author, design stage) must precede this roadmap at intake. Lean: lake env lean exit 0 with only the two sorry warnings, #check of all 10 declarations agrees with the README, one-tactic probes (simp, rfl, infer_instance) fail on both headlines; the other headlines are named in the docstring and are not statable at the pins. Gate OK as recorded by the worker. Four P3 notes: Langlands Lemma 11.6 is on p.142 of the IAS transcription, not p.205; Swan cited by whole-paper range for 0.3/9.4; Casselman read from a re-hosted GDZ scan; two style slips.
